# Real ultrasound reference figures

Original whole published figures, unmodified. This site uses NC material for noncommercial educational reference. No figure is generated from the 3D model. Figure panels, gestational age and cardiac phase are not interchangeable. Source-specific captions and limitations are displayed in the viewer.

## PMC3784141:F5
- File: PMC3784141-F5.jpg
- Figure source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3784141/#F5
- Original caption: (A) Apical four-chamber view of the fetal heart. (B) Color Doppler image shows forward flow from both atria to both ventricles. (C) Doppler waveforms of tricuspid and (D) mitral valves show a biphasic pattern. The E wave corresponds to early ventricular filing of the diastole, and the A wave corresponds to active ventricular filling of the diastole (atrial contraction). (D) Because of the continuity between mitral and aortic valves, the Doppler waveform at the mitral valve shows aortic outflow. Lt, left; Rt, right; LA, left atrium; RA, right A atrium; LV, left ventricle; RV, right ventricle; PV, pulmonary vein.
- SHA-256: 106ee1aaaef77efd74dab91cb0cc0be76f2f3780256b33493554a56606967904

## PMC3784141:F6
- File: PMC3784141-F6.jpg
- Figure source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3784141/#F6
- Original caption: Left ventricular outflow tract view. (A) This view shows the ventriculoarterial connection and intact ventricular septum. (B) Color Doppler across the aortic valve shows laminar flow and no turbulence in systole. Lt, left; Rt, right; LV, left ventricle; RV, right ventricle; Ao, aorta.

## PMC3784141:F8
- File: PMC3784141-F8.jpg
- Figure source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3784141/#F8
- Original caption: Three-vessel view. The main pulmonary artery, ascending aorta, and superior vena cava are arranged in a straight line from the left anterior to the right posterior aspect. The pulmonary artery is the largest in size, followed by the ascending aorta and the superior vena cava. The thymus is clearly visible anterior to the three vessels. Lt, left; Rt, right; MPA, main pulmonary artery; RPA, right pulmonary artery; DA, ductus arteriosus; Ao, aorta; SVC, superior vena cava; DAo, descending aorta.

## PMC3784141:F9
- File: PMC3784141-F9.jpg
- Figure source: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3784141/#F9
- Original caption: Three-vessel-trachea view. (A) This view demonstrates a V-shaped confluence of aortic and ductal arches at the descending aorta. (B) The trachea is located to the right side of the aorta. Color Doppler shows the same direction of blood flow in both arches. Lt, left; Rt, right; PA, pulmonary artery; DA, ductus arteriosus; AAo, ascending aorta; DAo, descending aorta; SVC, superior vena cava.
